regime_context: As of 2026-06-18, the Hong Kong thematic detector shows narrow leadership—Banks dominant (score 1.38), followed by High-Dividend and Industrials, the only three themes passing the absolute trend gate. No themes are crowded, and rotation signals no imminent handoff. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, but cross-sectional momentum ranks have no forward return edge.

theses.subject: Industrials & Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Among eligible themes, it has the highest durability bar (0.51, mixed hurst), suggesting a relatively stable uptrend without strong mean-reversion risk. While momentum rank is only fourth, the absolute-trend gate provides the drawdown discipline; an overweight orientation is warranted as long as that discipline holds.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank is only #4, lagging Banks and High-Dividend; if leadership narrows further into financials, Industrial flows could stall and the theme may turn range-bound.

falsifier.text: If the theme loses eligibility (eligible=false) in a subsequent update, or its durability_bar falls below 0.4 within the next 10 trading days.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The only scorable theme, but it fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false). The gate has a validated history of capturing shallower drawdowns; ineligible themes historically carry higher downside risk. Durability is low (0.32), and avoiding it aligns with the one documented edge.

falsifier.text: If China Tech & Internet regains eligibility (eligible=true) and its durability_bar rises above 0.4 within the next 10 trading days.
